list_latex_macros: list the frozenset constants defined in the latex constants module for macro categories
check_macro_category: check if a latex macro name belongs to a specific category frozenset like MACROS_IGNORED
identify_math_environments: identify math display environment prefixes and environment names from ENV_MATH_DISPLAY_PREFIXES and ENV_MATH
detect_table_rules: detect latex table rule macros from TABLE_MACROS_RULE for table structure parsing
filter_ignored_macros: filter out ignored latex macros like documentclass and usepackage from MACROS_IGNORED
